title: Roll back by plan digest

scenes.heading: Return to a known plan
scenes.sub: Find the earlier plan you want.
voice: A GPU stack change has a problem, and you want to restore the configuration you ran before.
Find that retained plan and identify it by its digest.

scenes.heading: Pin the earlier plan as target
scenes.sub: The plan becomes the rollout target.
voice: Switch the runtime selection policy to pinned and provide that plan digest.
The Operator sets the earlier plan as the target while the current plan stays active.

scenes.heading: Assess and approve the route back
scenes.sub: The transition starts from live state.
voice: The Operator assesses the transition from the active plan to your selected target.
In this example, restoring an earlier values file needs approval before the step can begin.

scenes.heading: Wait for the rollout result
scenes.sub: The earlier plan becomes active on success.
voice: Argo CD applies the steps in order, and the Operator checks readiness at each revision.
On success, the previously retained plan becomes the active plan again.
scenes.result: Active plan now matches pinned digest

viewer: GPU platform operators reversing a change
payoff: Select a retained plan by its digest, then assess and approve the transition back to it.
